correctness.rationale: For strictly ordered real data, the exact derivative is a positive-gap combination with coefficients C_{pi,k}. Rearrangement gives each exact maximum M_k. Hence the sharp bound mu, and all-time Gronwall contraction iff all M_k<=0. Orders with a concentrated gap show sharpness and strict expansion if M_k>0. Ties are handled by directional derivatives. 741152 exact permutation comparisons plus the 33/100 four-vertex derivative support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Provides a sharp polynomial-time decision criterion for variation dissipativity under arbitrary positive node masses, a best instantaneous amplification invariant, and a non-obvious first failure at four vertices despite Markov/vertex-space contraction.
